A [[human]] served as an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] '''prosecutor''' in the [[Niamos Courthouse|Courthouse]] on [[Niamos]]<ref name="Announcement">{{Andor|Announcement}}</ref> around [[5 BBY]].<ref name="Date">"[[Announcement]]" take place shortly after "[[Kassa (episode)|Kassa]]," which dates itself to [[5 BBY]].</ref> In conjunction with a [[Unidentified judge|judge]], they sentenced [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]]—under the alias of Keef Girgo—to six [[Standard year|years]] of [[Prison|detention]].<ref name="Announcement" />

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The character first appeared in "[[Announcement]]", the seventh episode of the live action television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', where they were portrayed by [[Glyn Pritchard]].<ref name="Announcement" />
